phase: FX Inflation Pass-Through — Transform, Lag and Window Preregistration
purpose: Freeze one parsimonious monthly predictive pass-through candidate family before any coefficient estimation. The cycle asks whether preregistered RON/EUR depreciation history adds predictive information for Romania monthly HICP inflation beyond inflation persistence, calendar seasonality and the retained total-import/world UVI external-price proxy. It does not identify exogenous exchange-rate shocks or causal structural pass-through.

source_methodology_boundary.external_price_proxy: ext_st_27_2020msbec / IMP / IVU / WORLD / TOTAL / RO
source_methodology_boundary.external_price_proxy_limit: UVI is composition-sensitive and is not a direct transaction-price import-price index.
source_methodology_boundary.exchange_rate: EXR.M.RON.EUR.SP00.A monthly average RON per EUR

regime_boundary.reason: Romania adopted inflation targeting in August 2005. Earlier retained months may be used only as lag/transformation history and never as target observations in this cycle.

seasonal_treatment.reason: Official HICP is not seasonally adjusted.
seasonal_treatment.method: Calendar-month fixed effects with January as the omitted reference month.

persistence_boundary.rationale: AR(2) is frozen as a compact monthly inflation-persistence baseline and is identical across external-price baseline and FX candidate.

external_price_baseline.rationale: Current and recent import-UVI changes are retained as an ex-ante external-price baseline. No longer UVI lag search is allowed in this cycle.

fx_lag_rationale: Historical Romania studies report most pass-through within the first 12 months and commonly report 3/6/9/12-month horizons. Fixed lag blocks reduce free parameters and prohibit post-fit lag-length selection while preserving coarse timing information.

external_price_baseline.equation: pi_t = alpha + month_FE + phi1*pi_t-1 + phi2*pi_t-2 + delta0*dpstar_t + delta13*dpstar_1_3_mean

fx_candidate.role: only admissible FX pass-through candidate in this cycle

fx_sign_interpretation.preregistered_direction: Cumulative 0-12 and cumulative 0-3 FX effects are expected to be non-negative for a depreciation-positive quote, but individual later block coefficients are not forced positive.

windows.structural_selection_method: Expanding-origin one-step-ahead monthly predictions. At each target month, each estimated model is fit only on eligible target months strictly earlier than that month.
windows.final_evaluation_open_rule: Open 2021-01..2026-06 only if the frozen FX candidate passes every structural-selection and identifiability gate in a separately authorized execution. Failure keeps the full final-evaluation window unopened.

next_gate: Implement an offline transformation and design-matrix builder that reproduces these frozen definitions, verifies target/lag dates and final-evaluation isolation, and defaults to no estimation. Then preregister numeric identifiability and structural-selection thresholds before any bounded selection execution.
